import csv
date='2018-01-06'
cols={'5b98cbc1-fd25-5d8c-a96e-c3de49819174':'cool','b7f22e0c-833d-5373-87e1-51e1cb26f038':'heat','e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8':'temp'}
data={k:{} for k in cols}
for ts,t,v in csv.reader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if ts in cols and t.startswith(date):
        data[ts][t]=float(v)
hours=sorted(data['e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8'])
count=0
for h in hours:
    temp=data['e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8'][h]
    cool=data['5b98cbc1-fd25-5d8c-a96e-c3de49819174'][h]
    heat=data['b7f22e0c-833d-5373-87e1-51e1cb26f038'][h]
    out = temp<heat or temp>cool
    if out: count+=1
    print(h, temp, cool, heat, out)
print('total hours',len(hours),'out',count)
